entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I bought this VeloBand Cadence Sensor and it's a complete piece of junk. It's not working and I want my money back. Now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with the sensor. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
A technical fault? It's broken! It won't sync with my app, it won't connect to my bike computer, the light just blinks. It's completely defective. I've tried everything. I'm not an idiot.
I understand your frustration, and I definitely didn't mean to imply that. Thank you for clarifying. Let me just pull up your account information to see what options we have.

Don't give me the runaround. I want a refund, not a troubleshooting session. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager and post a review about your defective products all over the internet?
There's no need for that, sir, I assure you I'm here to resolve this for you. Let me see... okay, I have your order. I see you received the VeloBand on December 15th, so about 24 days ago.
And? It shouldn't be broken already. That's terrible quality.
I completely agree, and I apologize for the experience. I'm checking our return policy now... and yes, it looks like you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window for a full refund.
Oh. Ninety days? Okay. So you can just take it back then?

Absolutely. I can process that for you right now. I'm generating a prepaid return label that I will email to you in the next few minutes. Just pack the defective unit in a box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll issue the full refund back to your original payment method.
Okay. Well, that's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
